card.name: Decimal point inside a number
card.fires_on: The decimal point (or sometimes a comma or digit) in the middle of a number, just after the first digits and before the rest. It appears in measurements, means, percentages and temperatures.

modes.label: Decimal point in statistics
modes.description: The point after the whole-number part of a mean, percent or measurement.

modes.label: Decimal point in temperatures
modes.description: The point inside a temperature value in degrees.

modes.label: Other inside-number marks
modes.description: A thousands comma or a digit partway through a number.

card.plain: It lights up on the dot in the middle of a number such as 18.4, before the last digits.
